entities.summary: Grace Nakimera is a Ugandan gospel musician, dancer, composer, and songwriter. Born on February 2, 1985, to Mr David Kalema and Ms Rose Nabulya, Grace attended Bat Valley Primary School and Old Kampala Senior Secondary School. She later enrolled for a course at the Revlon Beauty School in Nairobi.
